verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API with concrete endpoints, including toggling a feature from a deploy script and pulling experiment results. A hands-on probe created a user, an organization and a feature through the API on a self-hosted instance. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (every probed path returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
the first user and organization were created through the API, a boolean feature `pa-probe-flag` was created
